pca_sign_convention: per-component: coordinate with the largest |value| is forced positive
scale_derivation: max(|word_table_f32|) / 127 -- fixed from the word table alone, then reused as-is for the skill sums (see the comment above this block in distill.py for why: deriving it from max(|words|, |skills|) instead quantises almost every word vector to zero on this fixture).
skill_vectors_source: vectors.i8 is the Zipf-weighted sum of vocab word vectors from words.bin over each skill's concatenated fields, requantised with the SAME scale as words.bin -- NOT encoded by the teacher. See tools/bakeoff/README.md, 'the single most important rule'.
zipf_weight_formula: 1 / log(1 + rank_by_frequency), rank 1 = most frequent corpus word
